reason: E2 directly supports the high hardness and elevated-temperature wear resistance of FeCrNiTiZr and its potential as a repair material for H13 steel, but the hypothesis extends this to an unspecified damaged component and aggressive conditions without evidence. The premise that the coating will withstand the operating stresses and temperatures is not specifically supported by the cited passages.
